about.metaDescription: Learn about M/S. AZMIR ENTERPRIZE, a supplier of construction materials and transportation in Bangladesh.
about.title: About M/S. AZMIR ENTERPRIZE
about.description: We supply stone, sand, bitumen, coal, iron rod and bricks to buyers across their projects, and arrange transportation to the site.
about.focusDescription: Our focus is straightforward: help contractors, developers, engineers and procurement teams source the construction materials they need, with clear information and direct communication.
about.focusBody: From the river beds of Sylhet to the brick kilns and construction sites across the country, we keep four things moving: stone, coal, bricks and the trucks that carry them. Buyers get honest specifications, fair quantities and one point of contact from the first enquiry to the final delivery.

focusPoints.title: Stone
focusPoints.description: Boulder, single and crushed stone from Sylhet, Bholaganj and imported sources.

focusPoints.title: Coal
focusPoints.description: Steady coal supply for brick kilns and industrial buyers.

focusPoints.title: Bricks
focusPoints.description: Auto and kiln bricks for structural and finishing work.

focusPoints.title: Transport
focusPoints.description: Our own trucks deliver every order straight to your site.
